posts.title: The Von Pip Podcast – August 2026 | New Indie & Alternative Music
posts.description: PODCAST : It’s been a little while, but I’m back with another hour of music, old favourites and various things I’ve stumbled across and thought, “well that's a bit good.”

posts.title: Chloe Slater – “Mother Nature’s Killing Spree” | New Single
posts.description: Chloe Slater returns with “Mother Nature’s Killing Spree”, the latest single from her debut album Riot Youth, out October 9 via Stolen Juice.

posts.title: Echo & the Bunnymen – “Brussels Is Haunted”
posts.description: Echo & The Bunnymen return with "Brussels Is Haunted" The Bunnymen are back with their first new music in over a decade, and I really didn't expect it to be this good. Reports of the demise of Ian McCulloch's voice, it turns out, have been much exaggerated.
